concept.concept: A black cat sitting inside a jack-o-lantern with the text 'Most Likely to Be a Witch' in a wiggly Halloween font.
concept.audience: Cat owners who go all-in on Halloween decor and costumes, especially women 25-45.
concept.rationale: Halloween is the primary buying target (6-8 weeks out). Cat Halloween shirts consistently outperform generic Halloween designs. The self-deprecating 'witch' angle resonates with the core demographic and avoids IP issues entirely.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Most Likely to Be a Witch" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a black cat sitting inside a carved jack-o-lantern, centered composition. The cat's silhouette is solid black with two bright yellow circular eyes, sitting upright inside the pumpkin. The pumpkin is bright orange with a classic carved face: triangular eyes, triangular nose, and a wide grinning mouth, all cut out showing the dark background. Above the pumpkin in a playful wiggly Halloween-style font, the text 'Most Likely to Be a Witch' in solid black. Plain cream background, generous margin around all elements. Solid color blocks only: black, orange, yellow, cream. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Screen-print aesthetic, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast. Single centered design.
design.text_on_design: Most Likely to Be a Witch
design.style: Flat vector illustration, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, solid color blocks (black, orange, yellow, cream), no gradients, screen-print aesthetic, high contrast, readable at distance
